schema:
数据库: dw (数据仓库)
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
表 fact_order (订单事实表):
  order_id          VARCHAR(30) PK   -- 订单ID
  customer_id       VARCHAR(20)      -- 客户ID (FK→dim_customer)
  product_id        VARCHAR(20)      -- 商品ID (FK→dim_product)
  date_id           INT              -- 日期ID (FK→dim_date, 格式yyyyMMdd)
  region_id         VARCHAR(20)      -- 地区ID (FK→dim_region)
  order_quantity    INT              -- 购买数量
  order_amount      FLOAT            -- 订单金额

表 dim_customer (客户维度):
  customer_id       VARCHAR(20) PK
  customer_name     VARCHAR(50)
  gender            VARCHAR(10)      -- 男 / 女
  member_level      VARCHAR(20)      -- 青铜 / 白银 / 黄金 / 铂金

表 dim_product (商品维度):
  product_id        VARCHAR(20) PK
  product_name      VARCHAR(200)
  category          VARCHAR(50)      -- 手机数码/家用电器/鞋靴/服饰/食品饮料/休闲零食/图书文娱
  brand             VARCHAR(50)

表 dim_region (地区维度):
  region_id         VARCHAR(20) PK
  province          VARCHAR(50)      -- 省份
  region_name       VARCHAR(50)      -- 大区: 华北/华东/华南/华中/西南/东北/西北

表 dim_date (时间维度):
  date_id           INT PK           -- yyyyMMdd
  year              INT              -- 2025
  quarter           VARCHAR(2)       -- Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4
  month             INT              -- 1-12
  day               INT              -- 1-31

指标别名:
  GMV  = SUM(fact_order.order_amount)  -- 成交总额
  AOV  = SUM(order_amount) / COUNT(order_id)  -- 平均订单金额
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test_cases.category: 窗口函数 LAG 环比
test_cases.nl: 各季度GMV及环比增长率

test_cases.category: 窗口函数 LAG 月环比
test_cases.nl: 2025年各月GMV及环比增长率
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.month, ROUND(t.gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND((t.gmv - LAG(t.gmv) OVER(ORDER BY t.month)) / LAG(t.gmv) OVER(ORDER BY t.month) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct FROM (SELECT d.month, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.month) t ORDER BY t.month

test_cases.nl: 订单金额高于整体平均订单金额的订单占比

test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT d.month, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS gmv, ROUND(SUM(SUM(f.order_amount)) OVER(ORDER BY d.month), 2) AS cumulative_gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY d.month

test_cases.nl: 各商品品类的订单数占比
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(COUNT(f.order_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order), 4) AS order_ratio FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY order_ratio DESC

test_cases.nl: 各品类中女性客户消费金额占比
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = '女' THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.order_amount), 4) AS female_ratio FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY female_ratio DESC

test_cases.nl: 每个品类内部销量最高的前2个商品
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.category, t.product_name, t.quantity FROM (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(f.order_quantity) DESC, p.product_name) AS rn FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name) t WHERE t.rn <= 2 ORDER BY t.category, t.quantity DESC

test_cases.nl: 销售额高于其所属品类平均销售额的商品
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.product_name, t.category, ROUND(t.gmv, 2) AS gmv FROM (SELECT p.product_name, p.category, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv, AVG(SUM(f.order_amount)) OVER(PARTITION BY p.category) AS cat_avg FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name, p.category) t WHERE t.gmv > t.cat_avg ORDER BY t.category, t.gmv DESC

expected_result.product_name: 阿迪达斯 Ultraboost 跑鞋
耐克 Air Max 270 运动鞋

test_cases.nl: 各大区单笔金额超过1万元的大单订单占比
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.order_amount > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(f.order_id), 4) AS big_order_ratio FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY big_order_ratio DESC

test_cases.nl: 各会员等级的销量占比和销售额占比
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.member_level, ROUND(SUM(f.order_quantity) / (SELECT SUM(order_quantity) FROM fact_order), 4) AS qty_ratio, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount) / (SELECT SUM(order_amount) FROM fact_order), 4) AS gmv_ratio FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.member_level ORDER BY c.member_level

test_cases.nl: 各大区Q4销售额相对Q1的增长率
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN d.quarter = 'Q4' THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.quarter = 'Q1' THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.quarter = 'Q1' THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS q4_vs_q1_pct FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY r.region_name

test_cases.nl: 各省份订单数及其在所属大区内的占比
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, r.province, COUNT(f.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(COUNT(f.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(f.order_id)) OVER(PARTITION BY r.region_name), 4) AS ratio_in_region FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name, r.province ORDER BY r.region_name, order_count DESC, r.province

test_cases.nl: 铂金会员消费金额超过10万的品类
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.member_level = '铂金' GROUP BY p.category HAVING SUM(f.order_amount) > 100000 ORDER BY gmv DESC

test_cases.nl: 各品类订单金额分档统计 (低<500/中500-5000/高>5000)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(CASE WHEN f.order_amount < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN f.order_amount BETWEEN 500 AND 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN f.order_amount > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_orders FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

test_cases.nl: 消费金额排名前10的客户及其会员等级
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, c.member_level, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS gmv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(f.order_amount) DESC, c.customer_name) AS rn FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name, c.member_level ORDER BY gmv DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 10

test_cases.nl: 各季度销售额最高的大区
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.quarter, t.region_name, ROUND(t.gmv, 2) AS gmv FROM (SELECT d.quarter, r.region_name, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY d.quarter ORDER BY SUM(f.order_amount) DESC, r.region_name) AS rn FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY d.quarter, r.region_name) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.quarter
